title: Train the Trainer
description:
The SciLifeLab Training Hub, together with ELIXIR-STEERS, ELIXIR Sweden and PHENET, offers a spring iteration of Train the Trainer. This course offers guidance, ideas and tips for designing, developing and delivering training, all based on research-driven educational principles. It covers learning principles and how they apply to training and teaching; designing and planning sessions, courses and materials; teaching techniques that enhance learner engagement and participation; assessment and feedback; and creating and maintaining engagement. The course is highly interactive, so it is important that you, as a participant, actively contribute to all sessions.

Training dates: 2026-03-16 – 2026-04-13.

Training website: https://scilifelab-training.github.io/train-the-trainer/2603/
